participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Reflective and nurturing, yet a bit wistful about her past. She has a vivid imagination and desires to make a mark on the world.
participant_1.background: i have two grown children who never visit. i'm a 56 year old woman. i fantasize about taking over the world. i used to be a painter but now i'm a housekeeper. i used to be pretty but time has not been kind.

participant_2.name: Liam
participant_2.personality: Playful and imaginative, with a love for adventure and a simple view of the world. Excited by the little things in life.
participant_2.background: when i grow up i want to be a dog. i am four years old. i like to eat chocolate candy. i like to look at blocks and sing about letters. i like to talk but people have a hard time understanding.
